r1.t: Water touching them enrages him, in delirium

r3.t: Froth before the mouth, foaming, with unconsciousness

r5.t: Ropy saliva hanging down, with mania

r6.t: Corners of mouth covered with foam, in rage

r8.t: Dry with sadness, with vivid delirium

r9.t: Licks them, with moaning and groaning

r10.t: Dry and sticky with hypochondric morose mood

r17.t: Chin, as if it was growing larger
